g.text: Adopted operating millage minus rolled-back millage, per levy (a body can have more than one levy), tax year 2025. 1 mill = $1 per $1,000 of taxable value.
Source: hazeydata/openmillage-site data/rollback/fl-2025-rollback.csv (Florida Department of Revenue). Of 931 rows, 4 not plotted:
Duette Fire Rescue District (Manatee), North River Fire District (Manatee), King's Crest (Osceola), Law Enforcement (Santa Rosa)
- rolled-back rate printed as zero or not available, or adopted rate not available.
Some rows carry flags such as cross-source millage mismatches; plotted as published.
Out of scope: 6 exclusion entries in data/rollback/fl-2025-rollback-exclusions.csv
(incl. all school districts and many special districts, which have no statewide rolled-back source).
